analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($487.05) vs SMA5/20/50 ($470.31/$515.60/$512.43) — trading near the middle band, below short-term EMAs
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($400.22/$311.88) — above mid-to-long-term EMAs, forming strong support
· 52-week position (77.6%) — pullback from historical highs, currently in a consolidation phase
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (50.0→46.8) — moving sideways in neutral territory, hinting at potential weakening
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.8640→-8.3081) — continuing bearish trend, dead cross remains
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $515.60) — trading around the middle band, 26.03% band width indicates moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($460.21) — holding above 20-day low and Pivot S1 ($415.99)
· Swing resistance ($546.44) — facing resistance below 5-day high and R1 ($566.16)
· 5-day/20-day price pattern — no clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern, indicating a sideways range
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.55x) — below 5-day average volume, reducing conviction in price movements
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — considering potential downside due to bearish signals from RSI/MACD and low volume, maintaining a wait-and-see stance
analysis.patternNote: 현재 가격은 52주 고점 대비 약 16.6% 하락한 상태로, 20일 이동평균선 아래에서 횡보하며 방향성을 탐색하고 있다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is approximately 16.6% off its 52-week high, trading sideways below the 20-day moving average while seeking direction.
keyPoints: RSI가 50선 아래로 내려오며 약세 전환 가능성을 보이고, MACD 히스토그램도 지속적으로 악화되고 있어 매수 관점에서는 신중해야 한다.
거래량 비율이 0.55로 낮아 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도가 떨어지며, 이는 추세 전환보다는 횡보 구간의 특징이다.
주봉 RSI가 61.2로 여전히 강세 구간에 있지만, 일봉상 MACD 약세 신호와 거래량 위축은 단기적인 조정 가능성을 시사한다.
keyPointsEn: RSI dipping below 50 and worsening MACD histogram suggest caution for buyers.
Low volume ratio (0.55x) reduces conviction in current price action, typical of consolidation.
While weekly RSI remains strong at 61.2, daily MACD weakness and low volume hint at potential short-term pullback.
analysis.riskNote: ADX가 14.6으로 추세가 형성되지 않은 상태에서 RSI, MACD의 약세 신호와 거래량 위축이 동반되어, 급락 시 추세적 붕괴보다는 충격성 되돌림 가능성에 무게를 둔다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 14.6 indicating no trend, bearish signals from RSI/MACD coupled with low volume suggest potential shock-driven retracement rather than a trend breakdown.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. 금일 역시 RSI 중립 구간 횡보 및 ADX 무추세 지표가 유지되어 동일한 관망 판단을 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Today's indicators, including neutral RSI and a lack of trend on ADX, maintain this stance.
